[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tip 7: Start with a base price and adjust based on various factors.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tip 8: Round numbers (e.g., $20, $50, $100) are more attractive to customers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tip 9: Be prepared to negotiate prices at craft fairs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tip 10: Monitor sales and customer feedback to adjust pricing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Rough pricing guide: Small pieces ($10-$30), Medium pieces ($20-$50), Large pieces ($50-$100+), Functional pieces ($20-$50), Decorative pieces ($30-$100+).

[USER] User is considering whether to focus on selling functional or decorative pieces at the craft fair.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Pros of selling functional pieces: practical appeal, broad audience, competitive pricing.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Pros of selling decorative pieces: unique appeal, less competition, artistic expression.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cons of selling decorative pieces: niche appeal, pricing justification needed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendation: Start with decorative pieces to showcase creativity and develop style.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggestion: Bring a small selection of functional pieces if confident, but focus on decorative ones.
